bulk.attrDesc: Only the fields you set are changed; the rest keep their current value.
bulk.autoDerive: Empty = clear the manual value, fall back to auto-derived
bulk.cnameHint: Same as above. Unchecked = leave this field alone.
bulk.ignoreDesc: Ignored records are skipped by sync and no longer reported by expiry inspection.
bulk.ignoreWarn: Ignoring is neither deleting nor marking as fine — it means "we have decided not to deal with this for now". Ignored records stop appearing in alerts, so write down why, or nobody will know six months from now.
bulk.moduleHint: Empty means keep unchanged. To clear the module, enter a single space and save.
bulk.nothingSet: Nothing set, so there is nothing to save
bulk.originIpHint: A manual value overrides the auto-derived one. Empty + checked = clear it and fall back to auto.
bulk.reasonHint: Write it for yourself six months from now.

cert.ignoreNote: Once ignored, expiry checks stop reporting this entry. Nothing about its actual state changes — we have simply decided not to act on it.
cert.reasonHint: Nobody will remember why in six months. Be specific (e.g. internal-only host, decommissioned, pending cleanup).
cert.unignoreNote: This entry will be included in certificate expiry checks again.

col.stateHint: Flags exceptions only: ignored / domain left the account / domain parked. A dash means no exception — not missing data

coverage.allDone: All {{total}} host records have a project and module
coverage.next: Next: run “Auto-link modules” on the Domains page, or check the last relations_auto_link run under Scheduled tasks
coverage.noneAtAll: None of the {{total}} host records has a project or module. This is not a few missing rows — module auto-linking has never run or is not taking effect
coverage.partial: Of {{total}}: {{noProject}} without a project, {{noModule}} without a module

del.note: ⚠️ This deletes the CMDB ledger entry only; the actual DNS record is untouched and will likely reappear on the next sync. To stop resolution, use "DNS records" on the domain page.
del.title: Delete ledger entry

empty.noIgnoredReason: Every hostname is under normal management; none have been manually skipped.
empty.reason: Hostnames are synced in from the domains' DNS records. If a sync has never run, this is empty — it does not mean you have no hostnames. Run "Sync now" from the domains page.
empty.title: No hostnames in the ledger

error.title: The hostname ledger could not be loaded

form.certExpiryHint: Leave empty if unknown. An automatic probe overrides this value.
form.desc: Record who owns this host, which project it belongs to, and whether it is still in use.
form.hostHint: @ for the apex; e.g. www, api
form.notDns: This is the ledger, not DNS. Nothing here is written back to any DNS provider — to change real resolution, use "DNS records" on the domain page.
form.originHint: Manually recorded origin IP. When empty, the list shows a guess, labelled as such

noProjectHint: No owning project recorded. Cost attribution, alert routing, and decommission review all depend on this link

originRules.cnameHint: The domain the CDN points back to.
originRules.desc: Origin CNAME → origin IP. Used as a fallback when DNS cannot resolve the origin.
originRules.empty: No origin rules yet. They are only needed when DNS cannot resolve the origin.
originRules.title: Origin rules
